newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Peab says buys Pleiad Real Estate.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Peab says buys Pleiad Real Estate.

text.p: Swedish real estate company Peab AB said on Friday it would acquire Pleiad Real Estate AB for 545 million crowns.

Peab said in a statement the settlement for the deal would be 545 million crowns, of which 200 million crowns would be paid cash and the remaining 345 million would take the form of a debenture loan to the Pleiad's owners.

Peab said it would also make a cash rights issue totalling 223 million crowns. Peab shareholders will be entitled to acquire three new Peab shares at 14 crowns each for each 10 shares they currently hold in the company.
